items.question: Which obeisance mantra addressed to Ananta and Virajā must be placed again?
premises: The instruction prescribes placing a mantra formula.
The formula contains the bīja syllables oṃ and āṃ.
The obeisance is directed to Ananta and to Virajā.
items.inference: Therefore one should again place the mantra 'oṃ āṃ anantāya virajāyai natiḥ'.
items.plain_english: One should again place: 'oṃ āṃ, obeisance to Ananta and to Virajā.'
